description: What is physically loaded on the deck right now. This is the per-run file - edit it, do not edit deck.json or labware.json.

placements.name: tubes
placements.mount_note: Seated in slot 8, as the operator states. Grid spans X 148-256, Y 151-223, entirely inside slot 8's cell [132.25, 267.75] x [131.75, 225.25]. Grid centre (202, 187) is 8.7 mm from the slot centre. anchor_xy still supplies the origin; the slot is what the seating check validates it against.
placements.anchor_note: machine coords of well (row 0, col 0), current frame. The old scripts had X 186, written before the X limit grew by 70; +70 applied. Column index advances toward -X at 12.0 mm, row index toward -Y at 18.0 mm.

placements.name: tips

corners.note: Three measured WELL CENTRES, not the box outline - the 100 x 63.7 mm span is far smaller than an SBS footprint. The grid is solved from these so real pitch and any rack rotation fall out of the measurement.

solved.note: col_pitch = 100.0/11, row_pitch = 63.7/7. Assuming the nominal 9.00 would accumulate ~1.0 mm of X error by column 12 - enough to miss a tip. Solved centre X 68.0 vs slot 3 centre X 65.0 is a 3.0 mm slot offset, which is what confirmed the x' = 420 + x frame.

placements.stale_note: The old TIP_X, TIP_Y = 218, 309 station in examples/300ulaccuracyprecision.py points nowhere near this box (X 18-118, Y 335.5-399.2). It is stale and is not carried forward.
placements.slot_note: Slot 3, operator-confirmed 2026-08-26. The measured grid centre (68.0, 367.35) is 3.0 mm in X and 2.35 mm in Y from the slot centre. The PREVIOUS tip rack was in slot 4, and the old scripts' TIP_X, TIP_Y = 218, 309 refers to that one in the pre-shift frame: +70 gives (288, 309), which is a corner well of a rack seated in slot 4 (336, 272). Both the rack move and the frame shift explain that stale coordinate; it is not carried forward.

placements.name: water
placements.near_slot_note: Sits in slot 9 (65, 178.5). Kept as a station rather than slot-mounted because the stored coordinate is a DIP POINT, not the trough's centre: (70, 175) is 5.0 mm in X and 3.5 mm in Y from the slot centre.
